policies.title: Admin endpoints check the caller's role
policies.statement: Every endpoint in the admin API group calls the check_admin_role function as its first statement, passing the logged-in user, so no work runs before the role check. The check stops the request unless the user is an admin or a support_lead. An endpoint that must stay open to other roles is exempted by the policy owner, not by the endpoint author.

policies.title: Tenant reads and writes filter on org_id
policies.statement: Every read and write of the tenants table filters on org_id, so no statement reaches tenants across orgs without naming the org. Write the org_id predicate in the statement itself, on the tenants table, not in a called function. Use the org the request names, and do not drop the filter to fetch a tenant by id: fetch it with org_id as well.
